title: Jiggly Japanese Cotton Cheesecake
hookLine: Ultra-airy soufflé cheesecake that wobbles like a cloud and melts instantly on the tongue.

steps.title: Preheat Oven & Prep Your Pan
steps.instructionTemplate: Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C) and line your baking pan with parchment paper, leaving a slight overhang for effortless lifting. Measure out {cc_jp}, {milk_jp}, and {eggs_jp} so everything is ready and at room temperature for a silky, lump-free batter.

steps.title: Warm Cream Cheese Batter
steps.instructionTemplate: Gently melt {cc_jp} and {milk_jp} over warm water. Whisk in egg yolks and sifted {flour_jp} until satin smooth. Stir gently over low to medium-low heat until completely dissolved and glossy, scraping the sides so nothing crystallizes or scorches.

steps.title: Whip Egg Whites to Soft Peaks
steps.instructionTemplate: Whip egg whites from {eggs_jp} with {sugar_jp} until glossy soft-curved peaks form, then fold gently in thirds into the batter. Mix gently until just combined with no dry streaks remaining, then bake until the edges are golden and a toothpick comes out with moist crumbs.

steps.title: Bake in Water Bath for Cloud Rise
steps.instructionTemplate: Bake in a parchment-lined pan set in hot water at 300°F (150°C) for 55 minutes. Leave oven door cracked 10 mins to prevent deflation!
steps.criticalTip: Cracking the oven door for 10 mins prevents sudden temperature drop collapse.
steps.creatorSecret: Dip a sharp knife in hot water and wipe dry between every cut for razor-clean cafe slices.

ugcQuotes.quote: Turned out bakery-grade on my first try! Ready in 70 mins.
